# Dynamic Flanges and Fittings
> MS flange manufacturer and supplier in Mumbai (Darukhana, 400010). Makes and supplies MS flanges (blind, welding neck, slip-on, plate, E table), fittings (elbows, tees, reducers, end caps) and industrial pipes, quoted to the customer's drawing or specification.
